def interval_intersection(a, b):
    # a and b are lists of intervals (start, end)
    # returns the intersection as a list of intervals
    i = 0
    j = 0
    res = []
    while i < len(a) and j < len(b):
        a_start, a_end = a[i]
        b_start, b_end = b[j]
        # find overlap
        start = max(a_start, b_start)
        end = min(a_end, b_end)
        if start < end:
            res.append( (start, end) )
        # move the pointer which ends first
        if a_end < b_end:
            i += 1
        else:
            j += 1
    return res

    j = 0

    while i < len(a) and j < len(b):

        start = max(a_start, b_start)
        end = min(a_end, b_end)
        if start < end:

        if a_end < b_end:
            i += 1
        else:

    return res
